affine-official.description: Official first-party AFFiNE MCP endpoint (built into the self-hosted instance). Verified live against this instance: initialize 200 (server v1.0.1), read_document returns full doc content by docId, but doc_search returns SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE because workspace AI indexing is not enabled (semantic search would additionally require a server-stored Gemini BYOK key - cloud embedding, deliberately not enabled here). Effective surface today: read_document only. The advertised keyword+semantic search unlocks only if AI indexing is turned on. Credentials are read-only, per-client, revocable and expiring. Bridged to stdio via mcp-remote with --allow-http because the instance is plain HTTP on LAN (agent-ctrl does not render HTTP headers; same pattern as whph). Use for reading; keep the community DAWNCR0W server (affine) for search (titles), creation and editing.
